before.title: a chalk（✗）→ a piece of chalk（✓）
before.content: chalk 為不可數名詞，不可直接用 a chalk，須用 a piece of chalk。

after.content: 本課指書寫材料時通常作不可數名詞，一根粉筆用 a piece of chalk。詞典另收可數的粉筆條、顏色或種類用法，如 coloured chalks；不把本課標記擴成所有情境一律不可數。

facts.reason: Qualify the printed material-use rule without deleting the dictionary countable uses.

before.title: 不可數名詞搭配
before.content: a chalk（×）→ a piece of chalk（○）

after.content: 本課「一根粉筆」用 a piece of chalk；chalk 表材料通常不可數。另有粉筆條、不同顏色或種類的可數用法，如 coloured chalks。

facts.reason: Retain the classroom construction while explaining its actual scope.
Restore the missing5 in the first number; preserve both numbers in the unchanged English title.

before.title: audience 與 spectator 的分別
before.content: audience 是集合名詞（通常不加 s）；spectator 是可數名詞，複數需加 s。

after.content: audience 指一群觀眾的集合；spectator 指個別觀眾。計個別觀眾時用 spectators 或說 an audience of ...；audiences 可指不同場次或不同群體的觀眾。

facts.reason: Do not turn a collective-noun teaching distinction into a ban on the real plural audiences.

before.title: audience 表多寡的修飾語
before.content: audience 為集合名詞，表多寡時應使用 large 或 small 來修飾：many／few audiences（×）→ a large／small audience（○，許多／很少觀眾）。

after.content: 表一群觀眾人數多寡時，通常說 a large / small audience。many / few audiences 若指多／少個不同觀眾群體則可成立，不等於某一場觀眾人數多／少。

facts.reason: Qualify the size rule without deleting its useful classroom contrast or prohibiting multiple audiences.

before.content: n. 皺紋；vi. & vt. 起皺；詞族：wrinkled；片：wrinkle (up) one's nose

after.content: wrinkle (up) one's nose：皺起鼻子。wrinkle 也有名詞「皺紋」及動詞「起皺、使起皺」；wrinkled 為相關形容詞。
